purpose: Define the standalone Asset Mapper left-panel sheet stack. The stack indexes every known Havenwild source sheet/card while lazy-loading only the selected/visible sheet textures.
startupBehavior: Resolve repository root from current working directory or launcher.
Read project-owned asset lane catalogs where available.
Scan known source sheet roots for atlas images as a fallback.
Create sheet cards with provider, family, category, path, and mapped status.
Do not load every full-size PNG texture at startup.
Load the selected sheet texture on demand into the source preview panel.
greenCheckMeaning: A green sheet/tile badge means mapper metadata exists and satisfies the current mapping level. It does not mean runtime publication until the runtime/published status is present.
standaloneConstraint: This remains a Havenwild standalone tool until the GitHub-mirrored Ember ingest lane absorbs the generic parts.
